name: Sophie De Winter
bio:
Sophie's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. After graduating with a degree in communications, she started her career in the fashion industry. However, a chance visit to the Spa 24 Hours ignited a passion for racing. She quickly realized her marketing skills could be applied to the adrenaline-fueled world of motorsport. 

Sophie thrives on crafting compelling narratives and building brand awareness. She's a master of social media engagement, always looking for innovative ways to connect with fans. Her approach is detail-oriented, ensuring every campaign is meticulously planned and executed. Her experience in the fashion industry gives her a unique perspective on branding and visual appeal, setting her apart from others in the field. She is driven and dedicated to growing the presence of the Iron Dames team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Sophie is petite with a focused expression and always wears practical attire.

quirks: Always carries a notebook filled with marketing ideas.
Has a habit of tapping her pen when concentrating.
Keeps a small collection of vintage racing posters on her desk.
